messages.subject: Problem with a Shiny report
parts:
I am jammed with a problem that I cannot figure out.  Simply put, when using child=... with a code block, I cannot get the file reference to work.

A bit more info though, I want to store the children files in a separate folder and call them from the main report .Rmd file.  The main .Rmd is copied to a temp folder in server.R. 

I pass in the working directory as ddir when the reportQA.Rmd is called.  Then I try to construct an absolute reference to the child file location using paste().  This worlks fine when I test it, I get a proper file path sepcification.  But when the code block with child = is called, I get the following error:

Warning: Error in readLines: cannot open the connection

The report fails when it tries to open the first child.

The main .Rmd looks like this:
